speaker: BLUEARCADIA PORT AUTHORITY
text: We very much welcome your decision. It will help us remain competitive while investing in more sustainable infrastructure.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: I do not have concerns from a legal perspective, but keep in mind that moving the port is costly.

speaker: INFRASTRUCTURE MINISTRY
text: To make the relocation work, Arcadia will now have to construct a road bridge to Kalymera, turning a port decision into a major coastal infrastructure project.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Moving the port to Kalymera protects the port's long-term role and avoids increased shipping emissions, but it requires a major budget commitment.
